not_run: A PyTorch MLP on local Ollama embeddings is not run (no PyTorch dependency, and the predictor must stay Go-servable without an embedding model on the request path); ADR 0007 records it as a deferred ablation.
labels: costs are the recorded costs of each model on each item; no latency is measured or simulated in this experiment

lambda of the dual mode is retuned on the calibration split for each artifact with the same rule as the headline (the largest value whose calibration success reaches Best Single's minus 0.01); the test split is replayed once per artifact
calibration success is in-sample for the calibrators and lower-bound tables of every artifact (fitted on the same split lambda is tuned on)
because every operating point is retuned to the same calibration target, test success differs little by construction; the cost, the paired intervals and the pooled test ECE carry the comparison
better or worse means the paired 95% bootstrap interval against the shipped configuration lies wholly above or below zero; ECE is compared by its point estimate
pooled test ECE: 15 equal-mass bins over all models' test forecasts, recomputed in Python from the exported weights
training wall time is one run per artifact on this machine, measured around the whole fit and export; the shipped artifact was not retrained, its time is that of the committed train run
ablation artifacts are written under bench/scratch/ablations and are not committed
